_description: Recommended models for one-click setup. Embedding models use llama.cpp (GGUF) by default since it handles tokenization internally. ONNX models require additional tokenizer setup.

recommended.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
recommended.description: Lightweight 384-dim sentence transformer (23 MB GGUF). Good default for most codebases.

alternatives.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5
alternatives.description: Nomic embed text GGUF — 768-dim (274 MB). High quality, longer context.

alternatives.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
alternatives.description: BAAI general embeddings — 384-dim GGUF (44 MB). Strong retrieval quality.

recommended.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2
recommended.description: Cross-encoder reranker (90 MB). Improves retrieval ordering.
